snippet.description:

TOLOnews airs famous current affairs shows, including Farakhabar, Mehwar, Tawde Khabare, special interviews and town hall shows in Afghanistan’s national languages (Dari and Pashto). 

TOLOnews also produces documentaries. 

TOLOnews’ website (tolonews.com) provides news contents in Farsi, Pashto and English.

snippet.title: Kontra Channel
snippet.description:
Kontra Channel is a Greek television channel known for its focus on news, current affairs, and political commentary. It was launched in 2011 and has gained a reputation for its critical and often controversial stance on various political and social issues in Greece. The channel features a variety of programs, including talk shows, debates, and investigative journalism.

Kontra Channel is particularly noted for its oppositional perspective, which is reflected in its name "Kontra," meaning "against" in Greek. This stance has made it a significant player in the Greek media landscape, especially among viewers who seek alternative viewpoints and in-depth analysis of current events.

The channel has been involved in several high-profile discussions and has hosted numerous influential figures from the political, economic, and social spheres. Its programming often sparks debate and has a loyal viewership that appreciates its independent and often critical approach to news and current affairs.

snippet.title: The Accra Daily Mail.
snippet.description:
The Accra Daily Mail is a Ghanaian digital news and information publication covering Ghana, Africa and the wider world.

Based in Accra, the publication provides news, business journalism, company and industry profiles, politics, economic analysis, technology, health, sports, culture, entertainment and stories that help readers understand the issues shaping society and the economy.

Our aim is simple: to inform, explain and provide useful context.

We believe journalism should go beyond reporting what happened. It should also help readers understand why it matters, who is affected, what the wider implications are and what may happen next.

snippet.title: وكالة الأنباء السعودية
snippet.description:
وكالة الأنباء السعودية (واس) هي المصدر الرئيس للأخبار في المملكة العربية السعودية، تأسست عام 1971، تقدم أخبارًا دقيقة ولحظية عن الأحداث المحلية والدولية، مقرها الرياض. 
لدى الوكالة 18 مكتبًا داخليًا وخارجيًا، إضافةً إلى شبكة واسعة من المراسلين في العديد من الدول حول العالم.
تغطي (واس) مجموعة متنوعة من الموضوعات، تشمل الاقتصاد، والسياسة، والرياضة، والثقافة، والصحة، والتكنولوجيا، والبيئة.
اشترك في القناة الرسمية لوكالة الأنباء السعودية على يوتيوب للحصول على تحديثات منتظمة وآنية لأحدث الأخبار من المملكة العربية السعودية والعالم.

snippet.title: Blank SlateMedia
snippet.description:
Blank Slate Media is the publisher of three paid-circulation weekly newspapers on the North Shore of Long Island and a Long Island-wide website - the Great Neck News, the Williston Times, the New Hyde Park Herald Courier and TheIslandNow.com.
The company also represents five paid-circulation weekly newspapers published by Litmor Publications and the eight editions of the Queens Chronicle - an audited, bulk-distribution newspaper that covers all of Queens. The five Litmor publications are the Garden City News, Bethpage Newsgram, Jericho Syosset News Journal, Mid Island Times and Syosset Advance.
Combined, the 16 newspapers owned or represented by Blank Slate Media cover all of Queens and virtually the entire North Shore with a combined circulation of 200,000 and readership of 600,000.
With a separate newspaper for each community, businesses can target their markets and eliminate wasteful circulation -- making us the most cost-effective way to advertise.

snippet.title: RIK
snippet.description:
Καλώς ήρθατε στην επίσημη σελίδα του Ραδιοφωνικού Ιδρύματος Κύπρου (ΡΙΚ). Στόχος μας είναι η ενδυνάμωση της επικοινωνίας με το κοινό, μέσα στα πλαίσια της αποστολής μας για ενημέρωση, ψυχαγωγία και την προώθηση του πολιτισμού.

Όλες οι απόψεις είναι ευπρόσδεκτες, όπως και κάθε κριτική, εφόσον εκφράζονται με τρόπο που δεν παραβιάζει βασικές αρχές πολυφωνίας και κοινωνικής συνύπαρξης. Ως εκ τούτου: διαγράφουμε προσβλητικά, υβριστικά, ρατσιστικά, σεξιστικά και παρόμοιου τύπου σχόλια, και διαφημιστικές αναρτήσεις.  

Welcome to the official page of the Cyprus Broadcasting Corporation (CyBC).  We aim to further enhance our interaction with our audience within the context of our threefold role, to provide news broadcasting, entertainment and the promotion of culture. 

Spam, bullying and offensive comments will not be tolerated and commercial promotion is not allowed. We retain the right to delete posts and repeat offenders will be banned from this channel.
